opening.argument: The video demonstrates a routine customer-support integration: it explains that viewers may integrate a Facebook business page, route visitor messages into the REVE Chat dashboard, and reply from one place. The stated purpose is operational and instructional, consistent with the description of providing Facebook Messenger support and managing customer conversations. Nothing shown involves an investment, payment, or financial participation. Although the walkthrough includes Facebook account credentials and a login window, those elements appear within the integration process and do not establish credential theft, impersonation, or a deceptive outcome. The evidence therefore supports an ordinary technology demonstration focused on connecting a business page with a support dashboard.
